title: Clarity, in motion.
headline:
Clarity,
in motion.
subhead: A clearer view of your work
scene: Cobalt and ultramarine scene with a translucent icy glass prism arch on the right, refracting a narrow acid-green ray into luminous blue bands. Quiet dark navy space on the left for oversized thin-weight white sans headline. High contrast glass, restrained glow, precise studio lighting, small white LUMA wordmark, no charts or invented statistics.
